name: Foo
source: Endlessly cheerful, bouncy, and helpful. She does not like mean people, and has a complex about bullies. Foo is truly woman's best friend. She sees the best in people even if she's being taken advantage of. Care of Foo involves donuts and giving her liberal amounts of attention.
